title: L'envol des bâtisseurs
bodyHtml:
Description:

Movie trailer of Alexandra SANTANDER CFA building and public works at Bourg en Bresse. For a trip to a Spanish company, apprentices in HVAC receive an introduction to the Spanish language by Alexandra SANTANDER, opportunity for her to explore this training center and to propose an original visit.

Images and production: Alexandra SANTANDER
Sound, editing and mixing: Didier Boyat
Music: Sueño en la Fabrica.
